title: Explicit request detection
lesson: Describe both true and false. The 0.5 cutoff is a demonstration convention.

refund_requested.instructions: Does the author explicitly request a refund?

criteria.true: The author asks to have a payment returned or a charge reversed.
criteria.false: The author does not ask for money back; they may discuss refunds, ask about policy, or explicitly decline a refund.

cases.state: I want a refund for this order.
Could you reverse the duplicate charge?
Please give me my money back.
My refund arrived yesterday, thank you.
Please replace the item. I do not want a refund.
The replacement is unsuitable. Please refund the purchase price.
I would like the amount I paid to be returned to my card.
Do not send another replacement; send my money back instead.
Please reimburse me for the cancelled order.
The help page mentions refunds, but I only need delivery information.
Do not refund me. Please repair the item.
A refund would be possible under your policy. Can you explain the repair option?
You already returned the money; this message is just a thank-you.
